leo: Quick heads-up / PR #510 adds a micro migration note for Optimize toolkit (batching + quant profile example). Need a fast docs pass and a 3-line migration checklist. PR: https://github.com/redwood/optimize/pull/510 :link:
anya: Short Python snippet for v2 that shows batching + kv_prefetch: 
```py
from redwood import Client
client = Client(api_key=os.getenv('REDWOOD'))
# batch two prompts and enable kv prefetch
resps = client.batch.text.generate([{ 'model': 'redwood/opt-2', 'prompt': 'Summarize logs' }, { 'model': 'redwood/opt-2', 'prompt': 'List errors' }], options={ 'kv_prefetch': True })
for r in resps: print(r.text)
```
kevin: Suggested quant yaml (compact):
```yaml
precision: q8_0
kv_prefetch: true
shortseq_policy:
  max_tokens: 12
  fallback_precision: float32
```
Add a one-liner about cost: "q8_0 typically reduces memory ~2.5-3x; test on a small held-out set."
leo: Can someone run a quick smoke eval (10 prompts) and paste tokens/cost delta? small table ok.
ci-bot: label applied: docs/review-needed
anya: LGTM on snippets. I'll tidy wording and add the 3-line checklist to the PR description: 1) update SDK examples, 2) include quant profile + shortseq fallback, 3) run smoke eval and paste numbers.
kevin: Left a short line comment on the PR about preferring q8_0 before q4_0 for warm caches.
leo: Thanks all. On merge, ci-bot please post a short changelog blurb to #release-war-room.
ci-bot: will publish changelog entry on merge and ping #release-war-room.
